offers_products.reason: Sells financial products via its app: ExtraCash advances, Dave Checking accounts and debit card, subscription membership.

offers_services.reason: Financial services: ExtraCash short-term cash advances and banking accounts with partner bank, counted as services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sold to individual app members, 14M people needing cash between paychecks.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Only individual members use the app; no business or government buyers described.

recurring_revenue.reason: Members repeatedly take ExtraCash advances, pay express fees and membership, and use checking accounts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Customers use small advances for gas, groceries and bills; demand holds or rises when budgets tighten.

big_ticket.reason: ExtraCash advances are small, frequent amounts for everyday expenses like gas and groceries.

people_delivered.reason: Delivered by an app, CashAI underwriting technology and partner bank, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are individual households using a consumer mobile app.

asset_heavy.reason: Asset-light fintech app partnering with Coastal Community Bank; needs no plants, fleets or properties.
